$comment: Source of truth for engine routing. tier: free | restricted | paid. status: planned | experimental | ready. Only 'ready' engines may be used by skills. 'checked' is the date licence, stars and activity were last verified on GitHub.

engines.name: motion-reel
engines.purpose: Canvas films as a pure function of time: kinetic type, UI and product motion, 2D and three.js 3D, synthesized score and sound effects, frame-exact render.
engines.requirements: Node 18+, FFmpeg, Chromium via Playwright, uv for audio scripts. GPU strongly recommended for 3D (software WebGL is far slower).

engines.name: HyperFrames
engines.purpose: HTML and CSS compositions rendered to video: layouts, web-style motion, captions.
engines.notes: Optional GSAP animations use the GSAP licence (free, custom terms, not OSI): mark as restricted when used.

engines.name: Manim Community
engines.purpose: Equations, graphs, mathematical and technical diagrams.
engines.requirements: Python 3.10+, cairo, pango, FFmpeg; LaTeX for typeset maths.

engines.name: Blender (Python scripts)
engines.license_note: GPL covers Blender itself; films and scenes the user renders are theirs. Scripts that import bpy are GPL-bound.
engines.requirements: Blender 4.x. Without a GPU only Cycles on CPU is practical, which is slow.

engines.name: Lottie / animated SVG
engines.purpose: Lightweight vector animation for web and apps, exported as Lottie JSON or animated SVG.
engines.notes: lottie-web last pushed 2025-09; re-check maintained alternatives before building.

engines.name: Remotion
engines.license_note: Free for individuals and companies up to 3 people; larger companies need a paid company licence.
